---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement to an app
title: "[AppName] Short description"
labels: enhancement
---

**App**
Which app (`apps/<AppName>/`)? If it's a new app or a shared change, say so.

**Problem**
What's missing or awkward today? Who runs into this?

**Proposed change**
What you'd like to see. Sketches, mockups, or example inputs/outputs welcome.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approach you thought about and why it's not preferred.
